jobs.description:
SAP RAR Functional Consultant – SAP S/4HANA

**Experience:** 8\+ Years  
**Primary Skill:** SAP RAR  
**Good\-to\-Have Skills:** SAP BRIM, CI, SAP FI\-CA

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced SAP RAR Functional Consultant with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA, Revenue Accounting and Recognition (RAR), finance applications, and reporting toolsets.

The candidate will work closely with product managers, engineering teams, and finance stakeholders to design, implement, and optimize SAP RAR solutions supporting enterprise finance and accounting processes.

The ideal candidate should have hands\-on SAP RAR implementation experience, strong accounting knowledge, and the ability to perform proof of concepts, identify gaps, recommend solutions, and manage configurations.

Key Responsibilities

* Evaluate architectural options and support overall SAP RAR system architecture.
* Provide functional expertise and consulting support for SAP RAR applications and integrations.
* Develop and deploy new processes and configurations to meet business requirements.
* Conduct POCs, identify functional gaps, and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Collaborate with product managers, product owners, engineering, and IT teams.
* Support production issues, application maintenance, and enhancements.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and provide functional solutions.
* Participate in solution design and implementation activities.

Mandatory Skills \& Qualifications

* 8\+ years of experience in SAP Functional Consulting.
* Strong hands\-on experience in SAP RAR implementation with SAP S/4HANA.
* Experience working as a key functional resource in RAR implementations.
* Strong understanding of OTC, Revenue Recognition, IFRS, US GAAP, and ASC 606\.
* Detailed knowledge of accounting principles and SAP RAR functionality.
* Experience in BRF\+ configuration (Business Rule Framework).
* Experience implementing ASC 606 using SAP RAR or solutions such as RevPro.
* Experience with large\-scale RAR data migration.
* Integration experience between ECC, CC, S/4 BRIM, CI, and RAR.
* Experience in functional configuration, solution design, and gap analysis.

Good\-to\-Have Skills

* SAP BRIM
* SAP CI (Convergent Invoicing)
* SAP FI\-CA
* SAP RAR OCM
* Experience working in Agile environments.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Ability to translate business requirements into technical and functional solutions.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience collaborating with product and engineering teams.
* Ability to manage complex requirements and drive solutions independently.
* Good planning, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.

How to Apply

Interested candidates with strong hands\-on SAP RAR and S/4HANA implementation experience can apply using the link below.

**Application Link:**  
https://forms.gle/cnHwGmQZ6ZjZkhDC9

**Important:** SAP RAR is mandatory. Candidates with SAP BRIM, CI, and FI\-CA knowledge will be preferred.

Pay: ₹2,075,000\.00 \- ₹3,000,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP BRIM Data Analyst / Developer with strong hands\-on expertise in SAP BusinessObjects Data Services (BODS) and EMIGALL. The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in SAP BRIM data migration, ETL development, data transformation, validation, and reconciliation, particularly across SAP FI\-CA, Subscription Order Management (SOM), Convergent Charging (CC), and Convergent Invoicing (CI).

The candidate will be responsible for designing and developing ETL processes, configuring EMIGALL migration objects, supporting large\-scale SAP BRIM data migration initiatives, and ensuring data accuracy and integrity throughout the migration lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

* Analyze legacy source systems and map data to SAP BRIM target structures.
* Design, develop, and maintain SAP BODS jobs, workflows, scripts, and ETL processes.
* Develop source\-to\-target mappings and transformation logic.
* Configure and develop SAP EMIGALL migration objects and load programs.
* Support master data and transactional data migration, including FI\-CA, customer accounts, billing, and invoicing.
* Perform data extraction, cleansing, validation, and reconciliation.
* Develop SQL queries, validation scripts, and reconciliation reports.
* Troubleshoot BODS job failures, performance issues, and migration defects.
* Support mock conversions, migration testing, production cutover, and post\-go\-live activities.
* Collaborate with SAP BRIM functional consultants, data architects, and integration teams.
* Prepare technical documentation, mapping documents, ETL specifications, and migration procedures.

Required Technical Skills

* SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management)
* SAP BODS (BusinessObjects Data Services)
* SAP EMIGALL
* SAP FI\-CA (Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable)
* Subscription Order Management (SOM)
* Convergent Charging (CC)
* Convergent Invoicing (CI)
* SAP S/4HANA
* SQL and database technologies
* ETL development and data migration
* Data mapping, validation, and reconciliation
* Data quality management and troubleshooting

Required Experience

* 7\+ years of SAP data migration or data development experience.
* 4\+ years of hands\-on SAP BODS development experience.
* 3\+ years of hands\-on SAP EMIGALL development and migration experience.
* Proven experience in SAP BRIM or FI\-CA migration projects.
* Strong experience in developing BODS ETL jobs, workflows, and transformation logic.
* Hands\-on experience with EMIGALL migration objects and load processes.
* Experience with SAP S/4HANA integration and enterprise data migration initiatives.

Preferred Skills

* SAP Data Migration Cockpit.
* SAP HANA and SAP Datasphere.
* SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).
* Cloud\-based SAP environments.
* Experience in telecommunications, utilities, finance, transportation, or subscription\-based industries.
* Experience with Agile or hybrid delivery methodologies.

Education \& Certifications

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
* SAP BRIM certification.
* SAP Data Services certification.
* SAP HANA certification.
* SAP S/4HANA certifications are preferred.

Our Enterprise Performance team helps clients unlock value from enterprise platforms and digital technologies across finance, supply chain, manufacturing, and IT operations. In this role, you will work with business and technology teams to translate requirements into SAP BRIM solutions, support process improvement, and contribute to large\-scale transformation programs. You will bring functional knowledge, configuration experience, and a delivery\-focused approach to help clients improve operational efficiency and achieve sustainable business outcomes.


**Level**: Senior Consultant or equivalent

As a Senior Consultant, Functional Transformation at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for individually delivering high quality work products within due timelines. Need\-basis you will be mentoring and/or directing junior team members/liaising with onsite/offshore teams to understand the functional requirements.

jobs.title: SAP IS-U Billing Functional Lead
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**
================

 **Location: USA: Remote (Must be willing to work PST hours)**

  

Concentrix is looking for a highly experienced SAP IS\-U Billing Functional Lead to lead the design, configuration, testing, implementation, and support of SAP IS\-U Billing and Invoicing solutions for utility clients. This role requires deep functional expertise in utility billing processes, strong integration knowledge across SAP IS\-U modules, and the ability to drive complex billing transformation initiatives from requirements gathering through post\-production support.




The successful candidate will serve as the primary Billing SME, collaborating with business stakeholders, system integrators, technical teams, and project leadership to deliver innovative and compliant billing solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **SAP IS\-U Billing \& Invoicing**

* Lead the design, configuration, enhancement, and support of SAP IS\-U Billing and Invoicing solutions.
* Configure and maintain billing schemas, rate categories, operands, tariff structures, pricing configurations, and billing master data.
* Design and support invoice and bill print functionality, including customer\-facing billing outputs.
* Configure and maintain utility rate structures and pricing models aligned with business and regulatory requirements.
* Analyze and resolve complex billing exceptions, billing failures, invoicing errors, and outsort processing issues.
  

  

### **Time\-of\-Use (TOU), EDM \& Advanced Billing**

* Design and configure Time\-of\-Use (TOU) rates and billing scenarios.
* Support Energy Data Management (EDM) functionality, including interval data processing, profiles, and usage calculations.
* Implement and support advanced billing programs such as:
	+ Net Metering
	+ Aggregate Billing
	+ Renewable Energy Programs
	+ Distributed Energy Resources (DER)
	+ Emerging Utility Products and Services

  

### **Device Management Integration**

* Ensure accurate integration between Device Management and Billing processes.
* Support meter\-related processes including:
	+ Meter Reads
	+ AMI/Smart Meter Data
	+ Device Installations
	+ Device Removals
	+ Device Replacements
	+ Register Management
* Troubleshoot billing issues related to estimation, meter reading validations, implausible reads, and rate determination.
  

  

### **FICA Integration \& Meter\-to\-Cash**

* Manage billing integration with SAP FICA to ensure accurate invoice posting and financial processing.
* Support contract accounts, account determination, budget billing, dunning, collections, and payment processing.
